name: Flatheaded Hardwood Borer
desc: Flatheaded Hardwood Borer (Dicerca divaricata): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Dicerca divaricata, also known as the flatheaded hardwood borer, is a species of black coloured beetle from subfamily Chrysochroinae found in North America.
